preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.digestHelp: Instant: shown and sent as soon as it happens. Daily digest: kept in the inbox, then one summary of the day's unread notifications the next day (shown as a toast and emailed like the "Daily Digest" category). In-app only: kept in the inbox, no toast, email or summary. Days follow this computer's time zone.

emailUnavailable.server_endpoint_not_enabled: Email is not available yet: the Maintafox server has not enabled email sending for your organisation.
emailUnavailable.licence_blocked: Email is not available: your licence does not allow it in its current state.
emailUnavailable.device_not_activated: Email is not available: this device is not activated.

preferences.smsUnavailable: SMS is not available in this version.
